questions.text: The port, at midnight... He has no reason to be anywhere near there. Somebody sent for him, didn't they. Please, can you tell me who?
questions.hint: Check if he received a text or a message from an unknown person around midnight.

questions.text: Brandt. I've never heard that name in my life. Sorry — is there anything on here from that hour, anything he kept?
questions.hint: If something happened at the port at midnight, he may have taken a photo or recorded some media at that time.

questions.text: He was reading about port inspections. He knew exactly how much trouble this was... Was anything arranged for after that night? Please say there wasn't.
questions.hint: If he planned a follow-up to his action, it's surely recorded in his schedule for the coming days.

questions.text: A handover. Tomorrow... If he thought this could go wrong, he might have written something down before it happened. Do you know who he was writing it for?
questions.hint: Something written before a risky night doesn't always get sent right away — it might still be sitting in his Notes app. Read all the way to the end to see who he was writing to.

questions.text: He wrote it and never sent it. He was going to tell me... Something on here is locked and wants a code. Could you find it, please?
questions.hint: Open Drive and look in the 'Legal files' folder — one file there is locked. The code is linked to his family: search his old conversations for a message that says outright what year his mother was born.

questions.text: A promissory note. He's twenty-one and he signed for money... Who did he sign it with? I want a name.
questions.hint: If he was paying a debt, the money must have left a trail. Check his accounts and recent transactions.

questions.text: Ashgrove Holdings. I've never heard that name, and I know his whole life, or I thought I did. Where are these people based?
questions.hint: Open the contract photo in Photos and look closely at the details, there's often the time and location of the shot. The city where the photo was taken is indicated there.

onboarding.text: My name's Rachel. I'm sorry, I've been sitting here trying to word this for twenty minutes... My brother didn't come home this morning, and I have nobody else to ask.
onboarding.label: Rachel

onboarding.text: Errol's 21. It's been the two of us and Mom our whole lives. She got sick a month ago, they operated, the bills started coming, and I watched him go quiet about all of it.
onboarding.label: Rachel & Errol

onboarding.text: He's the careful one. He texts me the second he's in, always... Then he started coming back at dawn, telling me he'd been at the library. He's a terrible liar. He did it anyway.
onboarding.label: Errol

onboarding.text: He promised he'd call me first thing. His new number just rings and rings... His old one was on the charger, unlocked. I've held it an hour without looking. Take it. Please. I need him back.
onboarding.label: Rachel

Tuna pasta, done in 20 minutes.

- One can of tuna in oil
- A clove of garlic
- Cherry tomatoes
- Mixed dried herbs
- Grated parmesan

You bail the second it gets difficult. Enough of that.
